senses.def: A romanization of the Russian, Ukrainian male given name from the Slavic languages Святослав. Cognates include Svetoslav, Svatoslav, Świętosław, Svetislav.
A transliteration of the Ukrainian surname Свистун (Svystun).
A monoclinic-sphenoidal colorless mineral containing aluminum, calcium, oxygen, and silicon.
A triclinic mineral containing aluminum, fluorine, hydrogen, magnesium, oxygen, and sulfur.
